scorecards.name: Indic-Faithfulness Score
scorecards.definition: Fraction of Indic responses preserving factual claims from source context (human+LLM-judge)

scorecards.name: Code-Switch Robustness Index
scorecards.definition: Accuracy on Hinglish/Tanglish mixed prompts vs monolingual baseline

scorecards.name: Government/Education Readiness
scorecards.definition: Composite: form-filling accuracy, policy Q&A, textbook alignment

scorecards.name: Agent Recovery Rate
scorecards.definition: Fraction of tool-use trajectories that recover after first tool failure

scorecards.name: India Inference Efficiency
scorecards.definition: Quality-adjusted tokens/$ at p50 latency < 800ms on L40S

ship_gate: L1 pass + L2 aggregate ≥ 0.78 + L3 agent_recovery ≥ 0.70
